scope.summary: Implement a find/change surface operating across modes over layout content: literal text (metacharacter tokens, case/whole-word toggles); pattern/regex (capture groups, lookarounds, location tokens, formatting application); glyph (glyph ID / Unicode per font); object (search frames by object formatting, apply replacement attributes or object styles); and color (find a color usage and replace it). It MUST support saved/shared queries, predefined queries, and a search scope (all documents / document / story / to-end-of-story / selection) with include toggles for locked layers, hidden layers, parent pages, and notes. Model-steerable structured find/change commands.
acceptance_criteria: find/change across text/regex/glyph/object/color with saved queries, scope, and include toggles
proof_targets: five-mode find/change runtime; scope + include-toggle test
expected_tests: live: text/regex/glyph/object/color find-change each match+replace over the document
test: saved queries + scope selection + include toggles (locked/hidden/parent/notes) honored

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Find & change (text, regex, glyph, object, color)

risk_if_missed: No bulk edit/search; large documents unmaintainable; model cannot drive structured edits.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
